highlights.title: Split your Comp-Off into half days
highlights.description: Use one holiday credit as two half days. Choose AM or PM and keep track of the remaining balance.

highlights.title: Clearer timesheet text
highlights.description: Comp-Off reasons omit dates, headings resize to fit, and downloads use a clear month-and-year filename such as Optimum India_Timesheet Oct 2026.xlsx.

highlights.title: Simpler timesheet controls
highlights.description: Removed extra text from the Timesheet card and made its calendar button clearer in light and dark themes.

releaseNotes: Split a Comp-Off credit into two half-day bookings with AM/PM. Backups preserve and validate the remaining credit and sessions. Comp-Off reasons omit dates, and Excel headings resize to fit. Timesheet filenames now use the selected three-letter month and year without an employee ID. The Timesheet card now has less text and a clearer calendar button.
